release_scope: 0.1.1 desktop interface (Phase 2 of the reset, docs/ROADMAP.md): the six compiled DICE circuits behind the minimal desktop browser UI, played with keyboard, mouse and optional gamepads, with the About panel build string; touch controls, phone layouts, the qualification recorder and Home Screen/PWA support are removed. Desktop acceptance (the original/native/Wasm comparisons re-run for the six games and the desktop browser checks) is still pending, so it makes no desktop accuracy claim; the physical-device gate stays deferred.

desktop_acceptance.scope: Original/native/Wasm comparisons for the six ported games (Pong, Pong Doubles, Space Race, Breakout, Stunt Cycle, Indy 4) re-run against the reduced desktop frontend, plus the desktop browser checks in docs/TESTING.md in at least Chrome and Firefox. Scheduled for the 0.1.x patch releases (docs/ROADMAP.md).

physical_device_gate.basis: AGENTS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md: mobile/touch UI, phone device qualification, iPhone Home Screen/PWA support and any physical-device gate are deferred to the post-accuracy phase and do not gate desktop releases. The legacy device gate is history at tag legacy-0.6.0.
